references.text: Kefira is mentioned as one of the Gibeonite cities, the same city mentioned in Joshua 18:26
Kefira is listed among the cities where Judah's descendants settled after the exile
Mizpah in Benjamin is mentioned as a gathering place for the Israelites, the same Mizpah mentioned in Joshua 18:26
Mizpah was the place where Samuel gathered Israel and judged them, the same place mentioned in Joshua 18:26
Samuel called the people together to the Lord at Mizpah to choose a king
King Asa used stone and timber from Ramah to rebuild Mizpah
